title: Registry: tier status (Harbor app pair + PG/Redis datastore + VIP)
description: Runs `nexus status registry`. One table over the 4 registry-* nodes — registry-1/2 (Harbor app HA, RR DNS registry.nexus.lab) + registry-pg-1/2 (PostgreSQL 17 + Redis datastore HA; the VRRP VIP .119 holder labelled primary+vip). The unbuilt future platform-tools (prefect/unleash/marquez/backstage) in the same vms.yaml cluster are filtered out.

observe.what: 4-row table; registry-1/2 = harbor-app; registry-pg-1 = datastore/primary+vip; registry-pg-2 = datastore/replica; all alive; leader = the VIP-holding PG primary

whatProves: RegistryAdapter.GetStatusAsync resolves the platform-tools cluster, classifies only the registry-* nodes (harbor / registry-pg), probes the Harbor /api/v2.0/health per app node + the PG recovery role + the VRRP VIP holder, and rolls them into one table.
